name: code-review-loop
title: Code-review loop (environment fixed, triage policy learned)

origin.source: Created in this repository from a maintainer's diagram: generate, self-verify in parallel with an independent review, run automated checks, then ship, retry, or ask a person. The loop is a fixed machine with a sentinel proven unreachable; the triage decision is a JSON policy improved from event-log traces against a ground-truth objective with hidden tests. Runs on Claude Code headless.

comparison.purpose: An author writes a file, then self-checks it while a separate reviewer reviews it, and the task's visible tests run. A patch ships only when the checks pass and the reviewer approves, which canReach proves for every author, reviewer, and test result. Otherwise a JSON policy picks one legal option: retry with targeted feedback, or escalate. Escalated tasks wait for a person to ship as-is, request changes, or reject. Try the contradictory spec to see escalation.
